items.title: Henry "Booker T." Glass Interview, 1972-05-19
items.q: We named him Big Eye Louie. Playing in the band.

ctx.x: Booker T. Booker T, yeah. Booker T. We got the third reel on there, Buck, but we never did get about how Big Eye Louie got his nickname.

We named him Big Eye Louie. Playing in the band. When he'd get mad, you know, and we didn't ask for a number, and one of them would make a humbug, Louie would open up Big Eye, and Johnny Pedro would say, look at that Big Eye Rabbit. Big Eye Rabbit? Big Eye Rabbit. He used to call Big Eye Louie. He belonged to the child in the living room. Yeah. Big Eye Louie, all of them used to be .

items.title: Henry "Booker T." Glass Interview, 1962-03-22
items.q: Yeah. I was like, Big Al-Louis to be my clarinet player.

ctx.x: No, you're talking about a different Tillman. Yeah, he was playing drums. He was talking about the Tillman that played with John Kasman, John Kasman's cousin. Oh no, no, no. You never played with him. No. You played with him with John. Maybe that's Cornelius Tillman? Did you ever know Cornelius Tillman? I didn't know his other name, I just know him by Tillman. Oh, I see. He played with Wilbur, with John Kasman. Yeah. Well what about, did you ever play with Big Al-Louis?
Yeah. I was like, Big Al-Louis to be my clarinet player. With what band?
